headlines.headline: FLORIDA PROJECTED NO. 1 IN PRESEASON AP POLL FOR FIRST TIME SINCE 2006
headlines.detail: With the official preseason AP Top 25 due out before next week's season openers, multiple outlets project Florida as the No. 1 team, with Duke and Illinois rounding out the top three.

headlines.headline: NBA TIPS OFF 2026-27 SEASON TUESDAY; GIANNIS, LEBRON DEBUTS LOOM
headlines.detail: The new season opens Tuesday at 3 PM ET with Boston at Detroit. Giannis Antetokounmpo debuts for Miami on Oct. 21 and LeBron James begins a record 24th season with the 76ers.

headlines.headline: TRADE DEADLINE BUZZ: RAVENS LAND JURGENS, CARDINALS MOVE ON FROM HARRISON JR.
headlines.detail: Baltimore acquired center Cam Jurgens from Philadelphia, Arizona parted ways with receiver Marvin Harrison Jr., and Pittsburgh dealt CB Porter to Dallas.

headlines.headline: GEORGIA RISES TO NO. 1 AFTER TEXAS LOSS; NOTRE DAME, MIAMI ROUND OUT TOP THREE
headlines.detail: Georgia moved to No. 1 in the latest AP Top 25 after once-top-ranked Texas fell to No. 7 following a loss.
